## Definition of Done

Every box must be ticked or this PR cannot merge.

- [ ] Implementation code present
- [ ] Unit tests for any pure logic
- [ ] `teatest` golden tests for any UI change
- [ ] Integration test (`//go:build integration`) for any new CLI op
- [ ] In-app `?` help entry for any new keybind
- [ ] `docs/` page updated for any user-visible feature
- [ ] README cheatsheet updated when applicable
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` entry added under `## [Unreleased]`
- [ ] Config defaults updated (with comment) when applicable
- [ ] `vhs` demo tape added/updated for any new screen or flow
- [ ] `make ci` passes locally
